summary: Two overdue hikers in the red gully of Crestone Peak near Broken Hand Pass; Saguache SAR requested mutual aid and Custer County SAR took incident command after the vehicle was found at the upper South Colony trailhead at 0130 on 9/3. The hikers hunkered down overnight, were contacted at 0720 near 11,200 feet, and walked out.
location: Red gully of Crestone Peak near Broken Hand Pass
notes: Source: Custer County SAR Facebook page.
